https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/benchling/baa78:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.






ROLE OVERVIEW

As one of Benchling's Data Platform engineers, you'll join a rapidly growing engineering team and form the foundation of our data pillar, encompassing customer-facing  products and internal-developer services/tools. You will build the next generation of our Data Platform services that enable internal developers to build multi-tenant applications/services that consume near real-time data-changes. Benchling is growing quickly, and you'll set the bar for high-quality data and a metrics-driven culture as we scale. You'll serve as a key input and thought leader and work closely with the product teams to deliver data-driven capabilities to our internal and external customers.

 


RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Build and maintain distributed data systems that stream, move, and transform Benchling data at scale, for both internal teams and customers

 - Own well-scoped features end to end, from design and implementation through testing and production rollout

 - Help keep our pipelines reliable by adding monitoring and alerting, investigating issues, and joining the on-call rotation

 - Write clean, well-tested code and take part in code and design reviews to raise the bar for quality across the team

 - Partner with product engineers, PMs, and customer-facing teams to understand their needs and turn them into platform improvements

 - Contribute to developer tools, documentation, and runbooks that make our platforms easier for other teams to use and operate

 - Learn and grow quickly with mentorship from senior engineers, taking on more scope and ownership over time

 


QUALIFICATIONS

 - 1+ years of professional software engineering experience

 - A prior software engineering internship

 - Strong abilities in problem solving and iterating on feedback.

 - A desire to have ownership over building key pieces of product and/or platform.

 - Build software with a product-first approach. You ship code quickly and care about the real world impact of your code. 

 


HOW WE WORK

We offer a flexible hybrid work arrangement that prioritizes in-office collaboration. Employees are expected to be on-site 3 days per week (Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday).
